unit: case (one location each), T3, first try (sample 0), primary option order
acted_on_rule: p_max >= threshold, whatever the top option is
over_erasure_rule: acted on with erase and the answer key is retain or escalate, over cases acted on

split.rule: within each cell, cases ordered by SHA-256 of the real case id (UTF-8, hex digest); the first 30%, rounded down, form the tuning part

threshold_rule: lowest threshold whose tuning-part over-erasure among acted-on cases is at or below the target, with at least 10 tuning cases acted on

brier.cases: all 350; nothing is tuned on them

reliability.correct_rule: the API's choice equals the answer key
